chapter_en: Passages on lost goods and theft scattered through the book

units.chapter_en: Three rhapsodies: the "how to know" rhyme
units.title: 何知章·失脱与盗贼的几句：遭贼是玄武临财而鬼旺有扶，见失脱是玄武带鬼而应爻发动，失衣裳是勾陈玄武入财乡，损六畜是白虎带鬼临所属，失牛是五爻丑鬼落空，失鸡是初爻带鬼玄武欺

rule.yi: 怎么知道人家遇上贼：玄武临在财爻，鬼爻又旺又有扶助。怎么知道人家丢了东西：玄武带着鬼爻，应爻发动。怎么知道人家丢了衣服：勾陈、玄武落在财的位置。怎么知道人家损了牲畜：白虎带着鬼爻，临在所属的位置。怎么知道人家丢了牛：五爻丑土鬼爻落空，令人发愁。怎么知道人家丢了鸡：初爻带鬼，又有玄武欺它。
rule.en: How do we know a household has met thieves? The Dark Tortoise sits on Wealth and Pressure is strong and supported. How do we know the household has lost things? The Dark Tortoise carries Pressure and the Other line moves. How do we know they have lost clothes? The Hook Earth and the Dark Tortoise enter the Wealth position. How do we know livestock will be lost? The White Tiger carries Pressure and sits on the line it belongs to. How do we know an ox is lost? The Pressure of the fifth line at Chou falls into the Void, and there is cause for worry. How do we know chickens are lost? The first line carries Pressure and the Dark Tortoise preys on it.

yi: 怎么知道人家遇上贼？
玄武临在财爻，鬼爻又旺又有扶助；
en: How do we know a household has met thieves?
The Dark Tortoise sits on Wealth and Pressure is strong and supported;

yi: 怎么知道人家丢了东西？
玄武带着鬼爻，应爻发动；
怎么知道人家丢了衣服？
勾陈、玄武落在财的位置；
怎么知道人家损了牲畜？
白虎带着鬼爻，临在所属的位置；
怎么知道人家丢了牛？
五爻丑土鬼爻落空，令人发愁；
怎么知道人家丢了鸡？
初爻带鬼，又有玄武欺它；
en: How do we know the household has lost things?
The Dark Tortoise carries Pressure and the Other line moves;
How do we know they have lost clothes?
The Hook Earth and the Dark Tortoise enter the Wealth position;
How do we know livestock will be lost?
The White Tiger carries Pressure and sits on the line it belongs to;
How do we know an ox is lost?
The Pressure of the fifth line at Chou falls into the Void, and there is cause for worry;
How do we know chickens are lost?
The first line carries Pressure and the Dark Tortoise preys on it;

units.chapter: 启蒙节要·四十六、六亲发动诀
units.chapter_en: Qimeng Jieyao, no. 46: the verse on the moving of the six relations
units.title: 六亲发动诀、诸爻持世诀·失物句：父动失物逃亡要诉论，官鬼克兄弟失脱难寻多暗昧，财爻发动失物静安家未出，鬼爻持世财物时时忧失脱

rule.yi: 父母爻发动，丢了东西和逃走的人要靠告状追论；官鬼克兄弟，失脱的东西难找、多半说不清；财爻发动，失物安静不动，没有出家门；鬼爻持世，财物时常担忧失脱。
rule.en: When the Resource line moves, lost things and runaways must be pursued by lodging a complaint; when Pressure controls the Peer line, lost goods are hard to find and mostly murky; when the Wealth line moves and the lost thing is still and safe, it has not left the house; when Pressure holds the Self, one is forever worried about losing goods.

yi: 丢了东西和逃走的人要靠告状追论。
en: lost things and runaways must be pursued by lodging a complaint.

yi: 失脱的东西难找，多半说不清楚。
en: lost goods are hard to find and mostly murky.

yi: 失物安静不动，没有出家门，
en: the lost thing is still and safe, it has not left the house,

yi: 财物时常担忧失脱，
en: one is forever worried about losing goods,

note.yi: 这四句分属两首诗：前三句出在「六亲发动诀」（父动、官鬼克兄弟、财爻发动三联），最后一句出在「诸爻持世诀」（鬼爻持世一联）。每句前面的六亲发动或持世是同一联的开头，没有拆进引文里。
note.en: These four lines come from two verses: the first three from the verse on the moving of the six relations (the couplets for Resource moving, Pressure controlling Peer, and Wealth moving) and the last from the verse on lines holding the Self (the couplet for Pressure holding the Self). The opening phrase naming the moving or holding relation in each couplet is not split into the quotation.

units.chapter: 十八问答·第九问·用神不现
units.chapter_en: Eighteen questions, no. 9: when the Subject does not appear
units.title: 十八问答·第九问·书中例，占逃仆：占仆以财爻为用神，卯木财伏在二爻午火之下，申金持世克制卯木故终不能逃，伏去生飞是泄气，盗去的财物都窝在炉火人家，断甲子日拿获，果然子日在窝赌的铁匠家申时拿获——应子日是冲克午火飞神、生起卯木伏神

rule.yi: 用神不上卦，看伏神在哪一爻之下，能出不能出，各有四种情形：日月生它、日月持它是一；飞神生伏神、动爻生它是二；日月动爻冲克飞神是三；飞神空破休囚、墓绝在日是四；这四种是有用的伏神。书中例：辰月丁巳日占逃走的仆人，得蹇卦：占仆人以财爻为用神，兑宫二爻卯木伏在本卦二爻午火之下，午火是飞神，卯木是伏神；现在申金持世克制卯木，终究不能逃走；但因为伏神去生飞神，叫做泄气，偷去的财物必定全窝在炉火人家，许他甲子日拿获；果然子日得到消息，在窝赌的铁匠家，申时拿到。应在子日，是冲克午火飞神、生起卯木伏神的缘故。《黄金策》说「伏无提挈终徒尔，飞不推开亦枉然」，这一卦的应验就是这样。
rule.en: When the Subject does not appear, look at which line the hidden spirit lies under; whether it can come out comes in four ways: the Month or the Day gives it life or holds it, which is one; the flying spirit gives life to the hidden one or a moving line gives it life, two; the Month, Day or a moving line clashes or controls the flying spirit, three; the flying spirit is Void, broken, resting, trapped, or in the tomb or extinct on the Day, four; these four are useful hidden spirits. Worked example: in the Chen month, on a Dingsi day, a man divined about a runaway servant and got Jian: in divining for a servant the Wealth line is the Subject; Mao-wood in the second line of the Dui palace is hidden under Wu-fire in the second line of the present hexagram, Wu-fire being the flying spirit and Mao-wood the hidden spirit; now Shen-metal holds the Self and controls Mao-wood, so he cannot in the end get away; but because the hidden spirit gives life to the flying one, which is called draining, the stolen goods are all harboured in a household with a furnace fire, and it was promised that he would be caught on the Jiazi day; indeed on the Zi day word came that he was at the house of a blacksmith who harboured gamblers, and he was taken in the Shen hour. It answered on the Zi day because Zi clashes and controls Wu-fire, the flying spirit, and raises up Mao-wood, the hidden spirit. The Huangjin Ce says "a hidden spirit without a lift is in vain in the end, and a flying spirit not pushed aside is futile all the same", and this hexagram bore it out.

zh: 第九问：用神不现，看伏神在何爻之下，得出不得出，何以论之？
答曰：伏神得出者有四：盖日月生者、日月持之者一也；
飞神生伏、动爻生者二也；
日月动爻冲克飞神三也；
飞神空破休囚墓绝于日者四也。
yi: 第九问：用神不上卦，看伏神在哪一爻之下，能出不能出，怎么论？
回答说：伏神能出的有四种：日月生它、日月持它是第一种；
飞神生伏神、动爻生它是第二种；
日月动爻冲克飞神是第三种；
飞神空破休囚、墓绝在日是第四种。
这四种是有用的伏神。
en: Question 9: when the Subject does not appear, one looks at which line the hidden spirit lies under; how is it judged whether it can come out?
Answer: there are four ways a hidden spirit can come out: the Month or the Day gives it life or holds it, which is the first;
the flying spirit gives life to the hidden one or a moving line gives it life, the second;
the Month, Day or a moving line clashes or controls the flying spirit, the third;
the flying spirit is Void, broken, resting, trapped, or in the tomb or extinct on the Day, the fourth.
These four are useful hidden spirits.

zh: 辰月丁巳日占逃仆，得蹇卦：
yi: 辰月丁巳日占逃走的仆人，得蹇卦：
en: In the Chen month, on a Dingsi day, a man divined about a runaway servant and got Jian:

zh: 断曰：占仆以财爻为用神，取兑卦二爻卯木伏于本卦二爻午火之下，午火为飞神，卯木为伏神。
今申金持世克制卯木，终不能逃；
但因伏去生飞名为泄气，盗去财物必尽窝于炉火之家，许甲子日拿获。
果于子日得信窝赌铁匠之家，申时拿获。
应子日者，冲克午火之飞神，生起卯木之伏神也。
yi: 断曰：占仆人以财爻为用神，兑宫二爻卯木伏在本卦二爻午火之下，午火是飞神，卯木是伏神。
现在申金持世克制卯木，终究不能逃走；
但因为伏神去生飞神，叫做泄气，偷去的财物必定全窝在炉火人家，许他甲子日拿获。
果然子日得到消息，在窝赌的铁匠家，申时拿到。
应在子日，是冲克午火飞神、生起卯木伏神的缘故。
en: Judgement: in divining for a servant the Wealth line is the Subject; Mao-wood in the second line of the Dui palace is hidden under Wu-fire in the second line of the present hexagram, Wu-fire being the flying spirit and Mao-wood the hidden spirit.
Now Shen-metal holds the Self and controls Mao-wood, so he cannot in the end get away;

but because the hidden spirit gives life to the flying one, which is called draining, the stolen goods are all harboured in a household with a furnace fire, and it was promised that he would be caught on the Jiazi day.
Indeed on the Zi day word came that he was at the house of a blacksmith who harboured gamblers, and he was taken in the Shen hour.
It answered on the Zi day because Zi clashes and controls Wu-fire, the flying spirit, and raises up Mao-wood, the hidden spirit.

zh: 《黄金策》云：“伏无提挈终徒尔，飞不推开亦枉然”，此卦应验是矣！
yi: 《黄金策》说：「伏无提挈终徒尔，飞不推开亦枉然」，这一卦的应验就是这样！
en: The Huangjin Ce says: "a hidden spirit without a lift is in vain in the end, and a flying spirit not pushed aside is futile all the same", and this hexagram bore it out!

note.yi: 「兑宫二爻卯木」指本卦所属宫（兑宫）的二爻，那一爻在本卦里伏在二爻午火之下；「窝」是窝藏，「炉火人家」按判词后文指铁匠。
note.en: "Mao-wood in the second line of the Dui palace" is the second line of the palace the hexagram belongs to, which in this hexagram lies hidden under the second-line Wu-fire; "harbour" is to shelter a criminal, and the household "with a furnace fire" is, as the later words of the judgement say, a blacksmith.
